# Support

For setup and development questions, start with the [README](../README.md) and [Development guide](../Documentation/Development.md).

For public questions, bug reports and feature requests, search [existing issues](https://github.com/DimaMishchenko/currency/issues), then [open an issue](https://github.com/DimaMishchenko/currency/issues/new/choose) using the template. Include your app build, device and OS version, and describe what you tried. Issues and attachments are public; remove personal information and secrets.

For private support or privacy questions, email dimasike.dev@gmail.com, the contact listed in the [Privacy Policy](../Documentation/PrivacyPolicy.md). Share only information needed for your request. Community support is provided as time permits, with no guaranteed response time.

Report suspected vulnerabilities through the private route in [Security](SECURITY.md) and conduct concerns through the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
